title: PolicyEvaluationTrace
description: Ordered record showing how the policy gate reached a decision for one action proposal.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for this policy trace.

run_id.description: Run that this trace belongs to.

action_id.description: Action proposal evaluated by this trace.

evaluated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when this trace was created.

matched.description: Whether this rule determined the final result.

result.description: Outcome for this individual rule evaluation.

final_result.description: Final policy result for the action proposal.

deterministic_fingerprint.description: Stable SHA-256 hex digest matching the related policy decision.
